title: Value-Aligned Prompt Moderation via Zero-Shot Agentic Rewriting for Safe Image Generation
findings: The VALOR framework effectively detects and mitigates the generation of images depicting inappropriate behavior in culturally sensitive contexts, including religious venues. It achieves high accuracy (up to 98.7%) on the 'Value Alignment' task, which assesses performance in these scenarios, by rewriting prompts to ensure outputs align with social norms.
